correctness.rationale: Ore’s square-free criterion reduces the exceptions exactly to n=2m where m is square-free and every prime divisor of m is 1 mod 4. The Euler product for their indicator satisfies F(s)=zeta(s)^(1/2)G(s) with G holomorphic near 1. Evaluating G(1) using L(1,chi_4)=pi/4 and the Landau–Ramanujan Euler product gives B(y)~(4 K_LR/pi^2)y/sqrt(log y), hence E_sf(x)=B(x/2)~(2 K_LR/pi^2)x/sqrt(log x). Subtracting from the classical square-free count gives the displayed secondary term. The constant algebra checks exactly.
